description: Windwurfschadflächen Friederike NRW is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Dr. Stefan Franz. The damage areas of Hurricane Deep "Friederike" in January 2018 within the core damage zones and within North Rhine-Westphalia are shown. Coverage: Dr. Stefan Franz. The portal shows the English title as "Windfall damage areas Friederike NRW" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Dr. Stefan Franz. Its keywords include opendata, Windwurf, Kalamität, AGRI, Wald, Forst. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
